basic_info.description: Location! Location! Locations!  San Francisco home combines comfort with convenience. It features three bedrooms and two full bathrooms, offering ample space for families or anyone in need of extra room. The upper level features spacious 2 bedrooms, 1 full bathroom,  includes a bright and airy living room, creating a welcoming atmosphere. Adjacent to the living room is a spacious dining area and the kitchen, ideal for both everyday meals and entertaining. The lower level surprises with 1 bedrooms, 1 bonus room, perfect for a home office, playroom, or extra lounge space. The garage provides secure storage. Located near local shops, public transportation, and with easy access to major freeways, commuting and errands are a breeze. This home offers a flexible layout and prime location, making it an ideal choice for practical city living.
